slots.label: Leave year
slots.help: The calendar year the leave is accumulated for.

slots.label: As on date
slots.help: The date the accumulation is as on: 31 December of the leave year, or the retirement date when it is published on retirement.

slots.label: Total at the end of the year before
slots.help: The total at the credit at the end of the year before: the Leave Bank figure for that year, or the total of last year's order. Over 300 prints as restricted.

slots.label: Leave encashed on LTC this year
slots.help: The days encashed on LTC this year against the previous year's balance; 0 if none.

slots.label: Leave accumulated for the year
slots.help: The days accumulated for the year: 30, or what is left of 60 after the annual leave used.

slots.label: Annual leave used this year
slots.help: Days of annual leave used this year, with leave set against sick leave and study leave extensions. Only the 60-day check reads it; it is not printed.

templates.narrative: Advance payment of encashment for {ltc_days} days AL, on availing LTC, out of total accumulation of {accumulation} Days as per last year's leave accumulation (Col No 6).

slots.label: Date of the onward journey
slots.help: The proposed date of the outward LTC journey (note 6.2 and 7.2).

slots.label: Days of annual leave encashed
slots.help: The days of annual leave encashed on this LTC, ten at a time.

slots.label: Accumulation before this encashment
slots.help: The leave at the credit of the officer up to the previous year, before this encashment.

slots.label: This year's leave at credit
slots.help: Only if the leave is encashed from this year's entitlement: the days at credit for the year (note 6.6). Otherwise leave blank.

slots.label: Total encashed on LTC in all
slots.help: All the days encashed on LTC during service, counting these days.

templates.certificate: CERTIFICATE : ENCASHMENT OF LEAVE ON AVAILING LTC 1. Certificates for claiming advance of annual leave encashment on availing LTC:- 1.1. I have been granted (nature of leave) from ___________to ________ for _____________ number of days for availing LTC. AND / OR My family will avail LTC alone. 1.2. I / my family will perform LTC journey on free warrant / Form ‘D’ / authorize mode of transport for LTC and not under own arrangement e.g. own car etc. 1.3. I will submit LTC claim within a stipulated period of one month from the date of completion of journey as per Rule 17 TR. In case of cancellation of journey, I will refund the advance through MRO within a period of one month. If, I fail to do so, advance remitted to me will be recovered from my salary account by PCDA (O). 1.4. Total leave accumulated up to the previous calendar year is {accumulation} Days (name of unit part II order No……………….. dated ……………… refers). After the ibid encashment, balance of leave accumulated at credit is ……………….days*. (* minimum 30 days should be available at the credit of the officer.) 1.5. The total leave encashed on availing LTC during the entire year of service till date is {total_ltc} days inclusive of {ltc_days} days being availed now.
